parsed.name: XIA DXP 多道 X 射线能谱映射系统
parsed.name_en: XIA DXP X-ray Spectroscopy Mapping System
parsed.description: 这是一类基于 DXP 数字脉冲处理器和 MCA 多道分析器的 X 射线能谱采集系统，常与单通道或多通道探测器配合使用。它用于采集能谱、进行多元素或多像素映射测量，并在同步辐射与实验室 X 射线实验中支持 X 射线荧光等能量色散谱学应用。
parsed.description_en: This is an X-ray spectroscopy acquisition system based on DXP digital pulse processors and MCA multichannel analyzers, typically used with single-element or multi-element detectors. It is used to collect energy spectra, perform multi-element or pixel-by-pixel mapping measurements, and support energy-dispersive spectroscopy applications such as X-ray fluorescence in synchrotron and laboratory X-ray experiments.

actions.description: 获取数字脉冲处理器的底层参数。
actions.description_en: Get a low-level parameter from the digital pulse processor.

actions.description: 为能谱采集或映射测量预配置设备，如设置预置时间、采集模式及相关采集参数。
actions.description_en: Prepare the device for spectrum acquisition or mapping by applying preset time, acquisition mode, and related acquisition settings.
